decision: user 2026-10-30: probe, then skip unreferenced zone zeros only if proven

probe_1_prefilled.disk: 200 GB dynamic VHDX hot-added to the lab VM (SCSI 0:7), removed and deleted afterwards
probe_1_prefilled.steps: raw-fill first 30 GB with random bytes (254 s); GPT; Dev Drive ReFS format (2.7 s); metadata-inclusive bitmap; count 4 KiB zero granules in the zone; 20 GB stress (665 big files, 5,000 small, 30% deleted); guest reboot; verify
probe_1_prefilled.finding: the format left 99.99% of the zone zero although it had held random data, in 2.7 s: a TRIM/unmap the dynamic VHDX honours, not 22 GB of zero writes. So on a thin device format does clear the zone and this run cannot show whether ReFS tolerates old data there; the direct test (randomize every zero granule after format) follows.

probe_2_control_no_fill.note: no pre-fill; stress (665 big files, 5,000 small, 30% deleted) and guest reboot verified 3,952/3,952 files, Healthy; its zero count was skipped by a negative length bug and is superseded by probe 3

probe_3_randomized_zone.steps: fresh 200 GB dynamic VHDX; GPT; Dev Drive ReFS format (2.7 s); metadata-inclusive bitmap leading run = zone; count zero granules; disk offline; overwrite every all-zero 4 KiB granule of the zone with random bytes through the raw disk, keeping every nonzero granule (160 s); disk online; recount; Get-Volume

after_online.powershell_drive_P: absent (stress phase: "Cannot find drive. A drive with the name P does not exist.")

probe_3_randomized_zone.finding: ReFS no longer mounts once the zero granules of its reserved metadata-inclusive zone hold other data: the format relies on those zeros. Skipping unreferenced zone zeros during conversion is therefore unsafe unless the exact set of zero granules ReFS reads is authenticated; per the user decision (probe, then skip only if proven) the converter keeps writing every shadow-zero granule.

conclusion: zone_zero_skip disproved for the naive rule (all unreferenced zero granules); keep writing them. A narrower skip would need an authenticated complete ReFS footprint naming which zero granules ReFS does not read; not pursued.
